name: EMON Schema
description: Official EMON (Efficient Minimal Object Notation) schema definition. Supports nameless roots, suffix-based arrays (type[]), and explicit nulls.

definitions.description: Defines data structure (schema). Root is nameless; arrays use suffix notation.
Defines data rows matching a schema (starts with =). Values follow positional order.
Defines field data type. Primitives, custom types, or array suffixes are supported.
Triple-quoted block preserving line breaks. Converts to JSON string with \n.
Reference to a named nested type definition.
Comments start with // and are ignored by the parser.
